title: The Clinic After Hours
motive_summary: Elias had changed his will to redirect his cottage estate away from the village clinic. Nadia discovered this the previous evening and administered a fatal digoxin overdose disguised in his afternoon medication before he could reach the solicitor.
overview_text: 18:00 — Elias Grant, retired schoolteacher, found collapsed on his bench in the village square by Owen Price. No visible wounds, but his tea flask is spilled, his pill organiser lies open under the bench, and Elias had a known heart condition. The clinic's early-shift nurse, Nadia Cole, had checked on Elias at 17:05 as part of her routine — the last person to see him alive. The afternoon can be rewound from 16:00.
